<script>
var AUDIO_SRC = "data:audio/mpeg;base64,";

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {

});

var audioCtxUnlocked = false;
function startApp() {
  if (!audioCtxUnlocked) {
    try {
      var AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      var ctx = new AudioContext();
      var buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, 1, 22050);
      var source = ctx.createBufferSource();
      source.buffer = buffer;
      source.connect(ctx.destination);
      source.start(0);
      audioCtxUnlocked = true;
    } catch(e) {}
  }
  goTo('screen-intro');
}

var previousScreenLibrary = null;
var previousScreenSurvey = null;

function clearLearnMoreVibrate() {
  if (window._learnMoreVibrateInterval) {
    clearInterval(window._learnMoreVibrateInterval);
    window._learnMoreVibrateInterval = null;
  }
}

function goTo(screenId) {
  // Track where we came from for library back button
  var currentActive = document.querySelector('.screen.active');
  if (currentActive && screenId === 'screen-library') {
    previousScreenLibrary = currentActive.id;
  }
  if (currentActive && screenId === 'screen-survey') {
    previousScreenSurvey = currentActive.id;
  }
  clearLearnMoreVibrate();
  for (var k in audioPlayers) {
    if (audioPlayers[k] && !audioPlayers[k].paused) {
      audioPlayers[k].pause();
      updatePlayBtn(k, false);
    }
  }
  var screens = document.querySelectorAll('.screen');
  for (var i = 0; i < screens.length; i++) screens[i].classList.remove('active');
  var target = document.getElementById(screenId);
  target.classList.add('active');
  target.style.animation = 'none';
  target.offsetHeight;
  target.style.animation = '';
  window.scrollTo(0, 0);
  if (screenId === 'screen-quiz') { showDifficultySelect(); }
  if (screenId === 'screen-library') { renderLibrary(); }
  if (screenId === 'screen-complete') {
    var cnt = 0;
    for (var id in CARD_DEFINITIONS) { if (unlockedCards[id]) cnt++; }
    var total = Object.keys(CARD_DEFINITIONS).length;
    var el = document.getElementById('complete-text');
    if (el) {
      if (cnt > 0) {
        el.textContent = "You've explored Greyfriars Kirkyard and unlocked " + cnt + " character card" + (cnt !== 1 ? 's' : '') + "! Check your library to see which ones you're still missing.";
      } else {
        el.textContent = "You've explored Greyfriars Kirkyard! Play the quiz to unlock character cards.";
      }
    }
  }
}

var audioPlayers = {};

function getAudio(id) {
  if (!audioPlayers[id]) {
    var audio = new Audio();
    audio.preload = 'auto';
    audio.src = AUDIO_SRC;
    audio.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', function() {
      document.getElementById(id + '-duration').textContent = formatTime(audio.duration);
    });
    audio.addEventListener('timeupdate', function() {
      if (!audio.duration) return;
      var pct = (audio.currentTime / audio.duration) * 100;
      document.getElementById(id + '-progress').style.width = pct + '%';
      document.getElementById(id + '-thumb').style.left = pct + '%';
      document.getElementById(id + '-current').textContent = formatTime(audio.currentTime);
    });
    audio.addEventListener('ended', function() { updatePlayBtn(id, false); });

    var wrap = document.getElementById(id + '-progress-wrap');
    var seeking = false;
    function doSeek(clientX) {
      var rect = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
      var pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (clientX - rect.left) / rect.width));
      if (audio.duration) audio.currentTime = pct * audio.duration;
    }
    wrap.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) { seeking = true; doSeek(e.touches[0].clientX); e.preventDefault(); }, {passive: false});
    wrap.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e) { if (seeking) doSeek(e.touches[0].clientX); e.preventDefault(); }, {passive: false});
    wrap.addEventListener('touchend', function() { seeking = false; });
    wrap.addEventListener('click', function(e) { doSeek(e.clientX); });
    audioPlayers[id] = audio;
  }
  return audioPlayers[id];
}

function toggleAudio(id) {
  var audio = getAudio(id);
  if (audio.paused) {
    clearLearnMoreVibrate();
  for (var k in audioPlayers) {
      if (k !== id && audioPlayers[k] && !audioPlayers[k].paused) { audioPlayers[k].pause(); updatePlayBtn(k, false); }
    }
    audio.play().catch(function(e) { console.log('Play failed:', e); });
    updatePlayBtn(id, true);
  } else {
    audio.pause();
    updatePlayBtn(id, false);
  }
}

function updatePlayBtn(id, playing) {
  var btn = document.getElementById(id + '-play-btn');
  btn.innerHTML = playing
    ? '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="6" y="4" width="4" height="16" fill="white"/><rect x="14" y="4" width="4" height="16" fill="white"/></svg>'
    : '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><polygon points="6,3 20,12 6,21" fill="white"/></svg>';
}

function formatTime(s) {
  if (isNaN(s)) return '0:00';
  var m = Math.floor(s / 60);
  var sec = Math.floor(s % 60);
  return m + ':' + (sec < 10 ? '0' : '') + sec;
}

var currentDifficulty = null;
var currentQ = 0;
var score = 0;
var answered = false;
var selectedAnswers = [];
var matchPairs = {};
var matchActive = null;
var orderItems = [];
var fillGapSelections = {};
var dragIdx = null;

var bestScores = {};

function showDifficultySelect() {
  var libBtn = document.getElementById('quiz-library-btn');
  if (libBtn) libBtn.style.display = '';
  var container = document.getElementById('quiz-container');
  var levels = ['explorer', 'apprentice', 'historian', 'scholar'];
  var h = '<div class="screen-header"><div class="screen-label">Choose Your Challenge</div><div class="screen-title">Select Difficulty</div></div>' +
    '<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;margin-top:20px;">';
  for (var i = 0; i < levels.length; i++) {
    var key = levels[i];
    var data = QUIZ_DATA[key];
    var scoreText = data.questions.length + ' questions';
    if (bestScores[key] !== undefined) {
      scoreText = '<span style="color:var(--coral);font-weight:600;">' + bestScores[key] + '/' + data.questions.length + '</span> best score';
    }
    h += '<button class="quiz-option" onclick="startQuiz(\'' + key + '\')" style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">' +
      '<span style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;"><strong>' + data.label + '</strong><span style="color:var(--dark);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:1px;">' + '\u2605'.repeat(i + 1) + '</span></span>' +
      '<span style="font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);">' + scoreText + '</span></button>';
  }
  h += '</div>';
  h += '<div style="text-align:center;margin-top:20px;"><button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="goTo(\'screen-survey\')">Skip Quiz</button></div>';
  
  
  container.innerHTML = h;
  
  // Update counter
  var counterEl = document.getElementById('library-counter');
  if (counterEl) {
    counterEl.textContent = unlockedCount + ' / ' + totalCards + ' cards';
  }
  
  // Show congratulations if all cards unlocked
  if (unlockedCount === totalCards) {
    showAllCardsUnlocked();
  }
}

function startQuiz(diff) {
  currentDifficulty = diff;
  currentQ = 0;
  score = 0;
  renderQuestion();
}

function resetQ() {
  answered = false;
  selectedAnswers = [];
  matchPairs = {};
  matchActive = null;
  orderItems = [];
  fillGapSelections = {};
  dragIdx = null;
}

function getQuestions() { return QUIZ_DATA[currentDifficulty].questions; }

function renderQuestion() {
  var libBtn = document.getElementById('quiz-library-btn');
  if (libBtn) libBtn.style.display = 'none';
  resetQ();
  var questions = getQuestions();
  if (currentQ >= questions.length) { renderResults(); return; }
  var q = questions[currentQ];
  var container = document.getElementById('quiz-container');
  var levelIdx = ['explorer','apprentice','historian','scholar'].indexOf(currentDifficulty);
  var stars = '';
  for (var s = 0; s <= levelIdx; s++) stars += '\u2605';
  var h = '<div style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:8px;"><span style="color:var(--dark);font-size:14px;letter-spacing:4px;">' + stars + '</span></div>';
  h += '<div class="screen-header"><div class="screen-label">Question ' + (currentQ+1) + ' of ' + questions.length + '</div></div>';
  h += '<div class="progress-strip" style="margin-bottom:20px;">';
  for (var p = 0; p < questions.length; p++) {
    if (p < currentQ) h += '<div class="progress-dot done"></div>';
    else if (p === currentQ) h += '<div class="progress-dot current"></div>';
    else h += '<div class="progress-dot"></div>';
  }
  h += '</div>';
  h += '<div class="quiz-question">' + q.question + '</div>';
  if (q.instruction) h += '<p style="font-size:14px;color:var(--coral);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:16px;">' + q.instruction + '</p>';

  if (q.type === 'single' || q.type === 'odd_one_out' || q.type === 'fill_gap_single') h += renderSingleQ(q);
  else if (q.type === 'multi_select') h += renderMultiSelectQ(q);
  else if (q.type === 'true_false') h += renderTrueFalseQ(q);
  else if (q.type === 'fill_gap') h += renderFillGapQ(q);
  else if (q.type === 'match') h += renderMatchQ(q);
  else if (q.type === 'order') h += renderOrderQ(q);

  h += '<div id="quiz-feedback"></div>';
  container.innerHTML = h;
  
  // Update counter
  var counterEl = document.getElementById('library-counter');
  if (counterEl) {
    counterEl.textContent = unlockedCount + ' / ' + totalCards + ' cards';
  }
  
  // Show congratulations if all cards unlocked
  if (unlockedCount === totalCards) {
    showAllCardsUnlocked();
  }
  window.scrollTo(0, 0);
}

function renderSingleQ(q) {
  var h = '<div class="quiz-options" id="quiz-options">';
  for (var i = 0; i < q.options.length; i++) {
    h += '<button class="quiz-option" id="opt-' + i + '" onclick="selectSingle(' + i + ')">' + q.options[i] + '</button>';
  }
  h += '</div><div style="text-align:center;"><button class="btn btn-primary" id="submit-btn" style="opacity:0.5;pointer-events:none;" onclick="submitSingle()">Confirm</button></div>';
  return h;
}

function selectSingle(i) {
  if (answered) return;
  selectedAnswers = [i];
  var opts = document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-option');
  for (var j = 0; j < opts.length; j++) { opts[j].style.borderColor = 'var(--blush)'; opts[j].style.background = '#fff'; }
  document.getElementById('opt-' + i).style.borderColor = 'var(--coral)';
  document.getElementById('opt-' + i).style.background = 'var(--cream)';
  document.getElementById('submit-btn').style.opacity = '1';
  document.getElementById('submit-btn').style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
}

function submitSingle() {
  if (answered || selectedAnswers.length === 0) return;
  answered = true;
  var q = getQuestions()[currentQ];
  var isCorrect = selectedAnswers[0] === q.correct;
  if (isCorrect) score++;
  var opts = document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-option');
  for (var j = 0; j < opts.length; j++) {
    opts[j].style.borderColor = '';
    opts[j].style.background = '';
    opts[j].classList.add('disabled');
    if (j === q.correct) opts[j].classList.add('correct');
    if (j === selectedAnswers[0] && !isCorrect) opts[j].classList.add('incorrect');
  }
  showFeedback(isCorrect, q.explanation);
}

function renderMultiSelectQ(q) {
  var h = '<div class="quiz-options" id="quiz-options">';
  for (var i = 0; i < q.options.length; i++) {
    h += '<button class="quiz-option" id="opt-' + i + '" onclick="toggleMulti(' + i + ')" style="display:flex;align-items:center;text-align:left;"><span class="multi-circle" id="circle-' + i + '"></span>' + q.options[i] + '</button>';
  }
  h += '</div><div style="text-align:center;"><button class="btn btn-primary" id="submit-btn" style="opacity:0.5;pointer-events:none;" onclick="submitMulti()">Confirm</button></div>';
  return h;
}

function toggleMulti(i) {
  if (answered) return;
  var idx = selectedAnswers.indexOf(i);
  if (idx > -1) selectedAnswers.splice(idx, 1); else selectedAnswers.push(i);
  var circle = document.getElementById('circle-' + i);
  var btn = document.getElementById('opt-' + i);
  var checked = selectedAnswers.indexOf(i) > -1;
  if (checked) {
    circle.classList.add('checked');
    btn.style.borderColor = 'var(--coral)';
    btn.style.background = 'var(--cream)';
  } else {
    circle.classList.remove('checked');
    btn.style.borderColor = 'var(--blush)';
    btn.style.background = '#fff';
  }
  document.getElementById('submit-btn').style.opacity = selectedAnswers.length > 0 ? '1' : '0.5';
  document.getElementById('submit-btn').style.pointerEvents = selectedAnswers.length > 0 ? 'auto' : 'none';
}

function submitMulti() {
  if (answered || selectedAnswers.length === 0) return;
  answered = true;
  var q = getQuestions()[currentQ];
  var isCorrect = selectedAnswers.slice().sort().join(',') === q.correct.slice().sort().join(',');
  if (isCorrect) score++;
  var opts = document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-option');
  for (var j = 0; j < opts.length; j++) {
    // Reset inline styles so CSS classes take effect
    opts[j].style.borderColor = '';
    opts[j].style.background = '';
    opts[j].classList.add('disabled');
    if (q.correct.indexOf(j) > -1) {
      opts[j].classList.add('correct');
    } else if (selectedAnswers.indexOf(j) > -1) {
      opts[j].classList.add('incorrect');
    }
  }
  showFeedback(isCorrect, q.explanation);
}

function renderTrueFalseQ(q) {
  return '<div class="quiz-options" id="quiz-options">' +
    '<button class="quiz-option" id="opt-true" onclick="selectTF(true)" style="text-align:center;font-weight:600;">True</button>' +
    '<button class="quiz-option" id="opt-false" onclick="selectTF(false)" style="text-align:center;font-weight:600;">False</button>' +
    '</div><div style="text-align:center;"><button class="btn btn-primary" id="submit-btn" style="opacity:0.5;pointer-events:none;" onclick="submitTF()">Confirm</button></div>';
}

function selectTF(val) {
  if (answered) return;
  selectedAnswers = [val];
  document.getElementById('opt-true').style.borderColor = val ? 'var(--coral)' : 'var(--blush)';
  document.getElementById('opt-true').style.background = val ? 'var(--cream)' : '#fff';
  document.getElementById('opt-false').style.borderColor = !val ? 'var(--coral)' : 'var(--blush)';
  document.getElementById('opt-false').style.background = !val ? 'var(--cream)' : '#fff';
  document.getElementById('submit-btn').style.opacity = '1';
  document.getElementById('submit-btn').style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
}

function submitTF() {
  if (answered || selectedAnswers.length === 0) return;
  answered = true;
  var q = getQuestions()[currentQ];
  var isCorrect = selectedAnswers[0] === q.correct;
  if (isCorrect) score++;
  var trueBtn = document.getElementById('opt-true');
  var falseBtn = document.getElementById('opt-false');
  trueBtn.style.borderColor = '';
  trueBtn.style.background = '';
  falseBtn.style.borderColor = '';
  falseBtn.style.background = '';
  trueBtn.classList.add('disabled');
  falseBtn.classList.add('disabled');
  if (q.correct) { trueBtn.classList.add('correct'); if (!isCorrect) falseBtn.classList.add('incorrect'); }
  else { falseBtn.classList.add('correct'); if (!isCorrect) trueBtn.classList.add('incorrect'); }
  showFeedback(isCorrect, q.explanation);
}

function renderFillGapQ(q) {
  var h = '';
  for (var b = 0; b < q.blanks.length; b++) {
    var blank = q.blanks[b];
    h += '<p style="font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin:16px 0 8px;font-weight:500;">' + blank.label + ':</p>';
    h += '<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;">';
    for (var i = 0; i < blank.options.length; i++) {
      h += '<button class="quiz-option" id="gap-' + b + '-' + i + '" onclick="selectGap(' + b + ',' + i + ')" style="flex:1;min-width:100px;text-align:center;padding:14px 20px;">' + blank.options[i] + '</button>';
    }
    h += '</div>';
  }
  h += '<div style="text-align:center;margin-top:20px;"><button class="btn btn-primary" id="submit-btn" style="opacity:0.5;pointer-events:none;" onclick="submitFillGap()">Confirm</button></div>';
  return h;
}

function selectGap(b, i) {
  if (answered) return;
  fillGapSelections[b] = i;
  var q = getQuestions()[currentQ];
  var blank = q.blanks[b];
  for (var j = 0; j < blank.options.length; j++) {
    var btn = document.getElementById('gap-' + b + '-' + j);
    btn.style.borderColor = j === i ? 'var(--coral)' : 'var(--blush)';
    btn.style.background = j === i ? 'var(--cream)' : '#fff';
  }
  var allFilled = Object.keys(fillGapSelections).length === q.blanks.length;
  document.getElementById('submit-btn').style.opacity = allFilled ? '1' : '0.5';
  document.getElementById('submit-btn').style.pointerEvents = allFilled ? 'auto' : 'none';
}

function submitFillGap() {
  if (answered) return;
  var q = getQuestions()[currentQ];
  if (Object.keys(fillGapSelections).length < q.blanks.length) return;
  answered = true;
  var allCorrect = true;
  for (var b = 0; b < q.blanks.length; b++) {
    var blank = q.blanks[b];
    for (var i = 0; i < blank.options.length; i++) {
      var btn = document.getElementById('gap-' + b + '-' + i);
      btn.style.borderColor = '';
      btn.style.background = '';
      btn.classList.add('disabled');
      if (i === blank.correct) btn.classList.add('correct');
      if (i === fillGapSelections[b] && fillGapSelections[b] !== blank.correct) { btn.classList.add('incorrect'); allCorrect = false; }
    }
    if (fillGapSelections[b] !== blank.correct) allCorrect = false;
  }
  if (allCorrect) score++;
  showFeedback(allCorrect, q.explanation);
}

var matchPairColors = ['match-pair-0', 'match-pair-1', 'match-pair-2', 'match-pair-3', 'match-pair-4'];
var matchPairCount = 0;

function renderMatchQ(q) {
  matchPairCount = 0;
  var leftIsShort = q.left.every(function(l) { return l.length <= 6; });
  var h = '<div id="match-container">';
  if (leftIsShort) {
    h += '<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px;">';
    h += '<div style="flex:0 0 70px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;align-items:center;">';
    for (var i = 0; i < q.left.length; i++) {
      h += '<button class="quiz-option" id="ml-' + i + '" onclick="tapMatchLeft(' + i + ')" style="font-size:14px;padding:12px 8px;min-height:56px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;width:70px;font-weight:700;">' + q.left[i] + '</button>';
    }
    h += '</div><div style="flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;">';
    for (var i = 0; i < q.right.length; i++) {
      h += '<button class="quiz-option" id="mr-' + i + '" onclick="tapMatchRight(' + i + ')" style="font-size:13px;padding:12px;min-height:56px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;">' + q.right[i] + '</button>';
    }
    h += '</div></div>';
  } else {
    for (var i = 0; i < q.left.length; i++) {
      h += '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px;">';
      h += '<button class="quiz-option" id="ml-' + i + '" onclick="tapMatchLeft(' + i + ')" style="flex:1;font-size:13px;padding:12px;min-height:56px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;">' + q.left[i] + '</button>';
      h += '<button class="quiz-option" id="mr-' + i + '" onclick="tapMatchRight(' + i + ')" style="flex:1;font-size:13px;padding:12px;min-height:56px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;">' + q.right[i] + '</button>';
      h += '</div>';
    }
  }
  h += '</div>';
  h += '<p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;margin-top:8px;">Tap a date, then tap the event it matches.</p>';
  h += '<div style="text-align:center;margin-top:12px;"><button class="btn btn-primary" id="submit-btn" style="opacity:0.5;pointer-events:none;" onclick="submitMatch()">Confirm</button></div>';
  return h;
}

function tapMatchLeft(i) {
  if (answered) return;
  // If already paired, unpair it
  if (matchPairs.hasOwnProperty(i)) {
    var pairedRight = matchPairs[i];
    var mlEl = document.getElementById('ml-' + i);
    var mrEl = document.getElementById('mr-' + pairedRight);
    // Remove colour classes
    for (var c = 0; c < matchPairColors.length; c++) {
      mlEl.classList.remove(matchPairColors[c]);
      mrEl.classList.remove(matchPairColors[c]);
    }
    mlEl.classList.remove('disabled');
    mrEl.classList.remove('disabled');
    mlEl.style.borderColor = '';
    mlEl.style.background = '';
    mrEl.style.borderColor = '';
    mrEl.style.background = '';
    delete matchPairs[i];
    matchPairCount--;
    document.getElementById('submit-btn').style.opacity = '0.5';
    document.getElementById('submit-btn').style.pointerEvents = 'none';
    return;
  }
  
  if (matchActive !== null && matchActive.side === 'right') {
    // Complete a pair
    var colorClass = matchPairColors[matchPairCount % matchPairColors.length];
    matchPairCount++;
    matchPairs[i] = matchActive.idx;
    var mlEl = document.getElementById('ml-' + i);
    var mrEl = document.getElementById('mr-' + matchActive.idx);
    mlEl.classList.add(colorClass);
    mrEl.classList.add(colorClass);
    mlEl.classList.add('disabled');
    mrEl.classList.add('disabled');
    matchActive = null;
    checkMatchComplete();
  } else {
    clearMatchHL();
    matchActive = {side: 'left', idx: i};
    document.getElementById('ml-' + i).style.borderColor = 'var(--coral)';
    document.getElementById('ml-' + i).style.background = 'var(--cream)';
  }
}

function tapMatchRight(i) {
  if (answered) return;
  // If already paired, unpair it
  for (var k in matchPairs) {
    if (matchPairs[k] === i) {
      var mlEl = document.getElementById('ml-' + k);
      var mrEl = document.getElementById('mr-' + i);
      for (var c = 0; c < matchPairColors.length; c++) {
        mlEl.classList.remove(matchPairColors[c]);
        mrEl.classList.remove(matchPairColors[c]);
      }
      mlEl.classList.remove('disabled');
      mrEl.classList.remove('disabled');
      mlEl.style.borderColor = '';
      mlEl.style.background = '';
      mrEl.style.borderColor = '';
      mrEl.style.background = '';
      delete matchPairs[k];
      matchPairCount--;
      document.getElementById('submit-btn').style.opacity = '0.5';
      document.getElementById('submit-btn').style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      return;
    }
  }
  
  if (matchActive !== null && matchActive.side === 'left') {
    // Complete a pair
    var colorClass = matchPairColors[matchPairCount % matchPairColors.length];
    matchPairCount++;
    matchPairs[matchActive.idx] = i;
    var mlEl = document.getElementById('ml-' + matchActive.idx);
    var mrEl = document.getElementById('mr-' + i);
    mlEl.classList.add(colorClass);
    mrEl.classList.add(colorClass);
    mlEl.classList.add('disabled');
    mrEl.classList.add('disabled');
    matchActive = null;
    checkMatchComplete();
  } else {
    clearMatchHL();
    matchActive = {side: 'right', idx: i};
    document.getElementById('mr-' + i).style.borderColor = 'var(--coral)';
    document.getElementById('mr-' + i).style.background = 'var(--cream)';
  }
}

function clearMatchHL() {
  if (!matchActive) return;
  var el = document.getElementById((matchActive.side === 'left' ? 'ml-' : 'mr-') + matchActive.idx);
  el.style.borderColor = '';
  el.style.background = '';
}

function checkMatchComplete() {
  var q = getQuestions()[currentQ];
  if (Object.keys(matchPairs).length === q.left.length) {
    document.getElementById('submit-btn').style.opacity = '1';
    document.getElementById('submit-btn').style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
  }
}

function submitMatch() {
  if (answered) return;
  answered = true;
  var q = getQuestions()[currentQ];
  var allCorrect = true;
  for (var l in matchPairs) {
    if (q.correctPairs[l] !== matchPairs[l]) allCorrect = false;
  }
  if (allCorrect) score++;
  
  // Show correct pairings in order with colours
  var container = document.getElementById('match-container');
  var resultHTML = '';
  var correctColors = ['match-pair-0', 'match-pair-1', 'match-pair-2', 'match-pair-3', 'match-pair-4'];
  
  // Build correct pairs in chronological order (sort by left item value)
  var leftKeys = [];
  for (var k = 0; k < q.left.length; k++) leftKeys.push(k);
  leftKeys.sort(function(a, b) {
    var valA = parseInt(q.left[a]) || 0;
    var valB = parseInt(q.left[b]) || 0;
    if (valA !== 0 && valB !== 0) return valA - valB;
    return a - b;
  });
  
  for (var idx = 0; idx < leftKeys.length; idx++) {
    var li = leftKeys[idx];
    var ri = q.correctPairs[li];
    var colorClass = correctColors[idx % correctColors.length];
    resultHTML += '<div class="match-result-row">';
    resultHTML += '<div class="match-result-item match-result-left ' + colorClass + '">' + q.left[li] + '</div>';
    resultHTML += '<div class="match-result-arrow">&#8594;</div>';
    resultHTML += '<div class="match-result-item match-result-right ' + colorClass + '">' + q.right[ri] + '</div>';
    resultHTML += '</div>';
  }
  
  container.innerHTML = resultHTML;
  showFeedback(allCorrect, q.explanation);
}

function renderOrderQ(q) {
  orderItems = q.items.map(function(item, i) { return {text: item, origIdx: i}; });
  for (var i = orderItems.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    var j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    var t = orderItems[i]; orderItems[i] = orderItems[j]; orderItems[j] = t;
  }
  return '<div id="order-container">' + buildOrderHTML() + '</div>' +
    '<div style="text-align:center;margin-top:16px;"><button class="btn btn-primary" id="submit-btn" onclick="submitOrder()">Confirm Order</button></div>';
}

function buildOrderHTML() {
  var h = '<div id="order-list" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;">';
  for (var i = 0; i < orderItems.length; i++) {
    h += '<div class="quiz-option order-item" id="order-' + i + '" onclick="tapSwap(' + i + ')" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:grab;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;">';
    h += '<span style="font-size:14px;color:var(--coral);font-weight:700;min-width:24px;">' + (i+1) + '.</span>';
    h += '<span style="font-size:14px;flex:1;">' + orderItems[i].text + '</span>';
    h += '<span style="color:var(--muted);font-size:16px;">&#8661;</span>';
    h += '</div>';
  }
  h += '</div>';
  h += '<p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;margin-top:8px;">Tap an item to select it, then tap another to swap their positions.</p>';
  return h;
}

var tapSwapFirst = null;

function tapSwap(idx) {
  if (answered) return;
  if (tapSwapFirst === null) {
    tapSwapFirst = idx;
    document.getElementById('order-' + idx).style.borderColor = 'var(--coral)';
    document.getElementById('order-' + idx).style.background = 'var(--cream)';
  } else if (tapSwapFirst === idx) {
    document.getElementById('order-' + idx).style.borderColor = 'var(--blush)';
    document.getElementById('order-' + idx).style.background = '#fff';
    tapSwapFirst = null;
  } else {
    var t = orderItems[tapSwapFirst];
    orderItems[tapSwapFirst] = orderItems[idx];
    orderItems[idx] = t;
    tapSwapFirst = null;
    document.getElementById('order-container').innerHTML = buildOrderHTML();
  }
}

function dragStart(e, idx) {
  if (answered) return;
  dragIdx = idx;
  e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
}

function dragOver(e, idx) {
  e.preventDefault();
  e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
}

function dropItem(e, idx) {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (dragIdx === null || dragIdx === idx) return;
  var t = orderItems[dragIdx];
  orderItems[dragIdx] = orderItems[idx];
  orderItems[idx] = t;
  dragIdx = null;
  document.getElementById('order-container').innerHTML = buildOrderHTML();
}

function submitOrder() {
  if (answered) return;
  answered = true;
  var q = getQuestions()[currentQ];
  var isCorrect = true;
  for (var i = 0; i < orderItems.length; i++) {
    if (orderItems[i].origIdx !== q.correctOrder[i]) { isCorrect = false; break; }
  }
  if (isCorrect) score++;
  var items = document.querySelectorAll('.order-item');
  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    items[i].classList.add('disabled');
    items[i].style.cursor = 'default';
    if (orderItems[i].origIdx === q.correctOrder[i]) items[i].classList.add('correct');
    else items[i].classList.add('incorrect');
  }
  showFeedback(isCorrect, q.explanation);
}

function showFeedback(isCorrect, explanation) {
  var fb = document.getElementById('quiz-feedback');
  fb.innerHTML = '<div class="quiz-feedback ' + (isCorrect ? 'correct' : 'incorrect') + '">' +
    (isCorrect ? 'Correct! ' : 'Not quite. ') + explanation + '</div>';
  // Transform the confirm/submit button into Next Question
  var btnLabel = currentQ + 1 >= getQuestions().length ? 'See Results' : 'Next Question';
  var submitBtn = document.getElementById('submit-btn');
  if (submitBtn) {
    submitBtn.textContent = btnLabel;
    submitBtn.style.opacity = '1';
    submitBtn.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
    submitBtn.setAttribute('onclick', 'nextQuestion()');
  } else {
    // For match/order questions that auto-submit, add button in feedback
    fb.innerHTML += '<div style="text-align:center;margin-top:12px;"><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="nextQuestion()">' + btnLabel + '</button></div>';
  }
  fb.scrollIntoView({behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest'});
}

function renderResults() {
  var questions = getQuestions();
  var pct = Math.round((score / questions.length) * 100);
  if (bestScores[currentDifficulty] === undefined || score > bestScores[currentDifficulty]) {
    bestScores[currentDifficulty] = score;
  }
  var msg = pct >= 80 ? 'Excellent!' : pct >= 50 ? 'Well done!' : 'Keep exploring!';
  var container = document.getElementById('quiz-container');
  container.innerHTML = '<div class="screen-header"><div class="screen-label">' + msg + '</div><div class="screen-title">Quiz Complete!</div></div>' +
    '<div class="quiz-score"><div class="quiz-score-number">' + score + '/' + questions.length + '</div><div class="quiz-score-label">questions correct (' + QUIZ_DATA[currentDifficulty].label + ')</div></div>' +
    '<div style="margin-top:24px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;align-items:center;">' +
    '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="showDifficultySelect()">Try Another Difficulty</button>' +
    '<button onclick="goTo(\'screen-survey\')" style="background:none;border:none;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:13px;color:var(--coral);cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;margin-top:30px;touch-action:manipulation;">Skip to Survey</button></div>';
}

function nextQuestion() {
  if (window._learnMoreVibrateInterval) {
    clearInterval(window._learnMoreVibrateInterval);
    window._learnMoreVibrateInterval = null;
  } currentQ++; renderQuestion(); }

  if (currentDifficulty && currentQ > 0 && currentQ < getQuestions().length) {
    tryQuitQuiz();
  } else {
    goTo('screen-complete');
  }
}

  if (currentDifficulty && currentQ > 0) {
    document.getElementById('quit-quiz-modal').classList.add('active');
  } else {
    showDifficultySelect();
  }
}

  document.getElementById('quit-quiz-modal').classList.remove('active');
}

function confirmQuitQuiz() {
  document.getElementById('quit-quiz-modal').classList.remove('active');
  goTo('screen-complete');
}

// Override showFeedback to add learn-more to battle question
var originalShowFeedback = showFeedback;
showFeedback = function(isCorrect, explanation) {
  originalShowFeedback(isCorrect, explanation);
  
  var q = getQuestions()[currentQ];
  if (!q.options) return;
  
  var infoSource = null;
  var skipCorrect = true;
  
  // Battle question
  if (q.question && q.question.indexOf('What battle in 1679') > -1) {
    infoSource = battleInfo;
  }
  // Henrietta Maria question
  else if (q.question && q.question.indexOf('Henrietta Maria significant') > -1) {
    infoSource = henriettaInfo;
  }

  // McKenzie select all that apply
  else if (q.question && q.question.indexOf('true about George McKenzie') > -1) {
    infoSource = mckenzieInfo;
    skipCorrect = false; // All options have learn more, even correct ones
  }
  
  if (infoSource) {
    var opts = document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-option');
    for (var j = 0; j < opts.length; j++) {
      var optText = q.options[j];
      if (infoSource[optText]) {
        if (skipCorrect && q.type === 'single' && j === q.correct) continue;
        if (skipCorrect && q.type === 'multi_select' && q.correct.indexOf(j) > -1) continue;
        opts[j].classList.remove('disabled');
        opts[j].classList.add('learn-more-btn');
        (function(text) {
          opts[j].setAttribute('onclick', '');
          opts[j].addEventListener('click', function() { showLearnMoreFrom(infoSource, text); });
        })(optText);
      }
    }
    // Vibrate every time learn-more buttons shake (every 3s matching animation)
    if (infoSource) {
      playLearnMoreNotif();
      window._learnMoreVibrateInterval = setInterval(playLearnMoreNotif, 3000);
    }
  }
};

function showLearnMoreFrom(source, optionText) {
  var info = source[optionText];
  if (!info) return;
  document.getElementById('learn-more-title').textContent = info.title;
  document.getElementById('learn-more-text').textContent = info.text;
  document.getElementById('learn-more-modal').classList.add('active');
}

function checkCardUnlocks() {
  var newlyUnlocked = [];
  for (var id in CARD_DEFINITIONS) {
    if (unlockedCards[id]) continue;
    var card = CARD_DEFINITIONS[id];
    if (card.unlockCheck()) {
      unlockedCards[id] = true;
      newlyUnlocked.push(id);
    }
  }
  return newlyUnlocked;
}

var currentCardId = null;
var cardZoomedSection = null;

function showCardUnlock(cardId) {
  var card = CARD_DEFINITIONS[cardId];
  if (!card) return;
  currentCardId = cardId;
  
  // Reset to coral teaser mode
  document.getElementById('card-unlock-overlay').classList.remove('dark-reveal');
  document.getElementById('card-step-teaser').style.display = 'flex';
  document.getElementById('card-step-reveal').style.display = 'none';
  
  // Set custom teaser message or default
  var label = document.querySelector('#card-step-teaser .card-unlock-label');
  if (card.teaserMessage) {
    label.innerHTML = card.teaserMessage + '<br><span style="font-size:18px;margin-top:8px;display:block;">You unlocked a character!</span>';
  } else {
    label.textContent = 'You unlocked a character!';
  }
  
  // Set rarity
  var rarityEl = document.getElementById('card-unlock-rarity');
  rarityEl.textContent = card.rarity.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + card.rarity.slice(1);
  rarityEl.className = 'card-unlock-rarity rarity-' + card.rarity;
  
  // Preload image
  document.getElementById('card-unlock-img').src = card.image;
    
  document.getElementById('card-unlock-overlay').classList.add('active');
  playUnlock();
}

function revealCard(e) {
  e.stopPropagation();
  document.getElementById('card-step-teaser').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('card-unlock-overlay').classList.add('dark-reveal');
  var revealEl = document.getElementById('card-step-reveal');
  revealEl.style.display = 'flex';
  revealEl.style.animation = 'none';
  revealEl.offsetHeight;
  revealEl.style.animation = 'cardReveal 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)';
}

function zoomCard(section, e) {
  e.stopPropagation();
  var img = document.getElementById('card-unlock-img');
  
  if (cardZoomedSection === section) {
    // Zoom out
    img.style.transform = 'scale(1) translateY(0)';
    cardZoomedSection = null;
    return;
  }
  
  cardZoomedSection = section;
  var scale = 2.2;
  
  if (section === 'top') {
    img.style.transform = 'scale(' + scale + ') translateY(15%)';
  } else if (section === 'middle') {
    img.style.transform = 'scale(' + scale + ') translateY(-10%)';
  } else if (section === 'bottom') {
    img.style.transform = 'scale(' + scale + ') translateY(-35%)';
  }
}

var cardQueue = [];

function processCardQueue() {
  if (cardQueue.length > 0) {
    var cardId = cardQueue.shift();
    showCardUnlock(cardId);
  }
}

function dismissCard(e) {
  e.stopPropagation();
  document.getElementById('card-unlock-overlay').classList.remove('active');
  // Show next card in queue if any
  setTimeout(function() {
    if (cardQueue.length > 0) processCardQueue();
  }, 300);
}

// Hook into the quiz answer system to track results
function recordAndCheckCards(isCorrect) {
  questionResults[currentDifficulty + '_q' + currentQ] = isCorrect;
  if (isCorrect) {
    var newCards = checkCardUnlocks();
    if (newCards.length > 0) {
      cardQueue = newCards;
      setTimeout(processCardQueue, 600);
    }
  }
}

var _originalSubmitSingle = submitSingle;
submitSingle = function() {
  var q = getQuestions()[currentQ];
  var wasAnswered = answered;
  _originalSubmitSingle();
  if (!wasAnswered && answered) {
    recordAndCheckCards(selectedAnswers[0] === q.correct);
  }
};

var _originalSubmitMulti = submitMulti;
submitMulti = function() {
  var q = getQuestions()[currentQ];
  var wasAnswered = answered;
  _originalSubmitMulti();
  if (!wasAnswered && answered) {
    recordAndCheckCards(selectedAnswers.slice().sort().join(',') === q.correct.slice().sort().join(','));
  }
};

var _originalSubmitTF = submitTF;
submitTF = function() {
  var q = getQuestions()[currentQ];
  var wasAnswered = answered;
  _originalSubmitTF();
  if (!wasAnswered && answered) {
    recordAndCheckCards(selectedAnswers[0] === q.correct);
  }
};

var _originalSubmitFillGap = submitFillGap;
submitFillGap = function() {
  var q = getQuestions()[currentQ];
  var wasAnswered = answered;
  _originalSubmitFillGap();
  if (!wasAnswered && answered) {
    var allCorrect = true;
    for (var b = 0; b < q.blanks.length; b++) {
      if (fillGapSelections[b] !== q.blanks[b].correct) allCorrect = false;
    }
    recordAndCheckCards(allCorrect);
  }
};

var _originalSubmitMatch = submitMatch;
submitMatch = function() {
  var q = getQuestions()[currentQ];
  var wasAnswered = answered;
  _originalSubmitMatch();
  if (!wasAnswered && answered) {
    var allCorrect = true;
    for (var l in matchPairs) {
      if (q.correctPairs[l] !== matchPairs[l]) allCorrect = false;
    }
    recordAndCheckCards(allCorrect);
  }
};

var _originalSubmitOrder = submitOrder;
submitOrder = function() {
  var q = getQuestions()[currentQ];
  var wasAnswered = answered;
  _originalSubmitOrder();
  if (!wasAnswered && answered) {
    var isCorrect = true;
    for (var i = 0; i < orderItems.length; i++) {
      if (orderItems[i].origIdx !== q.correctOrder[i]) { isCorrect = false; break; }
    }
    recordAndCheckCards(isCorrect);
  }
};

// Check for card unlocks when showing results
// Also check cards at results for Bobby (complete any quiz) and Poltergeist (100% scholar)
var _originalRenderResults = renderResults;
renderResults = function() {
  _originalRenderResults();
  var newCards = checkCardUnlocks();
  if (newCards.length > 0) {
    cardQueue = newCards;
    setTimeout(processCardQueue, 800);
  }
};



// ========== STORY CARD UNLOCKS ==========
window._nextScreenAfterCard = null;
window._storyCardNextScreen = null;
window._pendingStoryCards = [];

function goBackFromSurvey() {
  if (previousScreenSurvey) {
    goTo(previousScreenSurvey);
  } else {
    goTo('screen-complete');
  }
}

function goBackFromLibrary() {
  if (previousScreenLibrary) {
    goTo(previousScreenLibrary);
  } else {
    goTo('screen-complete');
  }
}

function showLockedToast(el) {
  // Shake the card and vibrate
  el.classList.remove('shaking');
  el.offsetHeight;
  el.classList.add('shaking');
  playLockedVibrate();
  setTimeout(function() { el.classList.remove('shaking'); }, 500);
  
  // Show toast on the card itself
  var existing = el.querySelector('.toast-locked');
  if (existing) existing.remove();
  var toast = document.createElement('div');
  toast.className = 'toast-locked';
  toast.textContent = 'Locked';
  el.appendChild(toast);
  setTimeout(function() {
    if (toast.parentNode) toast.parentNode.removeChild(toast);
  }, 1000);
}

function viewCardWithReveal(cardId) {
  var card = CARD_DEFINITIONS[cardId];
  if (!card) return;
  currentCardId = cardId;
  window._nextScreenAfterCard = null;
window._storyCardNextScreen = null;
  
  // Skip teaser, go straight to dark reveal with animation
  document.getElementById('card-step-teaser').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('card-unlock-overlay').classList.add('dark-reveal');
  
  document.getElementById('card-unlock-img').src = card.image;
    
  var revealEl = document.getElementById('card-step-reveal');
  revealEl.style.display = 'flex';
  revealEl.style.animation = 'none';
  revealEl.offsetHeight;
  revealEl.style.animation = 'cardReveal 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)';
  
  document.getElementById('card-unlock-overlay').classList.add('active');
  playUnlock();
}

function viewCardDirect(cardId) {
  var card = CARD_DEFINITIONS[cardId];
  if (!card) return;
  currentCardId = cardId;
  cardZoomedSection = null;
  window._nextScreenAfterCard = null;
window._storyCardNextScreen = null;
  
  document.getElementById('card-step-teaser').style.display = 'none';
  var revealEl = document.getElementById('card-step-reveal');
  revealEl.style.display = 'flex';
  revealEl.style.animation = 'none';
  
  document.getElementById('card-unlock-img').src = card.image;
    document.getElementById('card-unlock-overlay').classList.add('active');
  playUnlock();
}

function unlockStoryCard(cardId, nextScreen) {
  if (!unlockedCards[cardId]) {
    unlockedCards[cardId] = true;
    window._storyCardNextScreen = nextScreen;
    var card = CARD_DEFINITIONS[cardId];
    if (card) {
      currentCardId = cardId;
      document.getElementById('card-unlock-overlay').classList.remove('dark-reveal');
      document.getElementById('card-step-teaser').style.display = 'flex';
      document.getElementById('card-step-reveal').style.display = 'none';
      
      // Set custom teaser message or default
      var label = document.querySelector('#card-step-teaser .card-unlock-label');
      if (card.teaserMessage) {
        label.innerHTML = card.teaserMessage + '<br><span style="font-size:18px;margin-top:8px;display:block;">You unlocked a character!</span>';
      } else {
        label.textContent = 'You unlocked a character!';
      }
      
      var rarityEl = document.getElementById('card-unlock-rarity');
      rarityEl.textContent = card.rarity.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + card.rarity.slice(1);
      rarityEl.className = 'card-unlock-rarity rarity-' + card.rarity;
      document.getElementById('card-unlock-img').src = card.image;
            document.getElementById('card-unlock-overlay').classList.add('active');
      playUnlock();
      return;
    }
  }
  goTo(nextScreen);
}

function dismissCard(e) {
  if (e) e.stopPropagation();
  document.getElementById('card-unlock-overlay').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('card-unlock-overlay').classList.remove('dark-reveal');
  
  if (cardQueue.length > 0) {
    setTimeout(processCardQueue, 300);
  } else {
    // Check for retroactive unlocks (e.g. Henrietta after Charles)
    var newCards = checkCardUnlocks();
    if (newCards.length > 0) {
      cardQueue = newCards;
      setTimeout(processCardQueue, 500);
    } else if (window._storyCardNextScreen) {
      var next = window._storyCardNextScreen;
      window._storyCardNextScreen = null;
      setTimeout(function() { goTo(next); }, 300);
    }
  }
}

// ========== LIBRARY ==========
function renderLibrary() {
  var container = document.getElementById('library-content');
  var cardOrder = [
    {section: 'Common', cards: ['mary', 'bobby', 'charles', 'burke', 'hare']},
    {section: 'Uncommon', cards: ['margaret', 'mckenzie']},
    {section: 'Rare', cards: ['henrietta']},
    {section: 'Legendary', cards: ['poltergeist', 'knox']}
  ];
  
  var unlockedCount = 0;
  var totalCards = Object.keys(CARD_DEFINITIONS).length;
  for (var id in CARD_DEFINITIONS) {
    if (unlockedCards[id]) unlockedCount++;
  }
  
  // Update chapter complete text
  var completeText = document.getElementById('complete-text');
  if (completeText) {
    completeText.textContent = "You've explored Greyfriars Kirkyard and unlocked " + unlockedCount + " character card" + (unlockedCount !== 1 ? 's' : '') + "! Check your library to see which ones you're still missing.";
  }
  
  var h = '';
  for (var s = 0; s < cardOrder.length; s++) {
    var section = cardOrder[s];
    var rarityClass = 'rarity-' + section.section.toLowerCase() + '-label';
    h += '<div class="library-section-label ' + rarityClass + '">' + section.section + '</div>';
    h += '<div class="library-grid">';
    for (var c = 0; c < section.cards.length; c++) {
      var id = section.cards[c];
      var card = CARD_DEFINITIONS[id];
      var isUnlocked = unlockedCards[id] === true;
      
      if (isUnlocked) {
        h += '<div class="library-card" onclick="viewCardWithReveal(\'' + id + '\')">';
        h += '<img src="' + card.image + '" alt="' + card.name + '">';
        h += '</div>';
      } else {
        h += '<div class="library-card locked" style="background:none;cursor:pointer;position:relative;" onclick="showLockedToast(this)">';
        h += '<img src="' + CARD_LOCKED_SRC + '" alt="Locked" style="filter:none;">';
        h += '</div>';
      }
    }
    h += '</div>';
  }
  
  container.innerHTML = h;
  
  // Update counter
  var counterEl = document.getElementById('library-counter');
  if (counterEl) {
    counterEl.textContent = unlockedCount + ' / ' + totalCards + ' cards';
  }
  
  // Show congratulations if all cards unlocked
  if (unlockedCount === totalCards) {
    showAllCardsUnlocked();
  }
}



function openFullscreenCard(imgSrc) {
  document.getElementById('card-fullscreen-img').src = imgSrc;
  document.getElementById('card-fullscreen-overlay').classList.add('active');
  // Scroll to top of image
  document.getElementById('card-fullscreen-wrapper').scrollTop = 0;
}

function closeFullscreenCard() {
  document.getElementById('card-fullscreen-overlay').classList.remove('active');
}



// ========== SOUND EFFECTS ==========
var audioCtx = null;

function getAudioCtx() {
  if (!audioCtx) {
    audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
  }
  return audioCtx;
}



function playUnlock() {
  try {
    var ctx = getAudioCtx();
    var notes = [523, 659, 784, 1047];
    for (var i = 0; i < notes.length; i++) {
      var osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      var gain = ctx.createGain();
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.type = 'sine';
      var t = ctx.currentTime + i * 0.12;
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.08, t);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + 0.3);
      osc.frequency.value = notes[i];
      osc.start(t);
      osc.stop(t + 0.3);
    }
  } catch(e) {}
}





var congratsShown = false;

function showAllCardsUnlocked() {
  if (!congratsShown) {
    congratsShown = true;
    document.getElementById('congrats-overlay').classList.add('active');
    playCongratsChime();
  }
}

function dismissCongrats() {
  document.getElementById('congrats-overlay').classList.remove('active');
}

function dismissCongratsToSurvey() {
  document.getElementById('congrats-overlay').classList.remove('active');
  goTo('screen-survey');
}



function playCongratsChime() {
  try {
    var ctx = getAudioCtx();
    var notes = [523, 659, 784, 1047, 784, 1047, 1319, 1568];
    for (var i = 0; i < notes.length; i++) {
      var osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      var gain = ctx.createGain();
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.type = 'sine';
      var t = ctx.currentTime + i * 0.1;
      var vol = i < 4 ? 0.1 : 0.12;
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, t);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + 0.4);
      osc.frequency.value = notes[i];
      osc.start(t);
      osc.stop(t + 0.4);
    }
    // Add a final sustained chord
    var chordNotes = [1047, 1319, 1568];
    for (var j = 0; j < chordNotes.length; j++) {
      var osc2 = ctx.createOscillator();
      var gain2 = ctx.createGain();
      osc2.connect(gain2);
      gain2.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc2.type = 'sine';
      var t2 = ctx.currentTime + 0.8;
      gain2.gain.setValueAtTime(0.08, t2);
      gain2.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t2 + 0.8);
      osc2.frequency.value = chordNotes[j];
      osc2.start(t2);
      osc2.stop(t2 + 0.8);
    }
  } catch(e) {}
}



function playLearnMoreNotif() {
  try {
    if (navigator.vibrate) {
      navigator.vibrate([50, 30, 50]);
    }
  } catch(e) {}
}

function playLockedVibrate() {
  try {
    if (navigator.vibrate) {
      navigator.vibrate([30, 20, 30]);
    }
  } catch(e) {}
}
